reasoning: 驗證目標：已在清單底端時請求 Scroll Down，回捲至清單頂端。為什麼這樣切：與 138 為方向相反的一對，條款分列，邊界與回捲目標皆不同，各自成片（§8.2.1）；同樣以越界前後各一次觀察構造判準。

tcs.tc_title: Scroll Down at the bottom of the list wraps to the top
tcs.test_item: If a Scroll Down is requested and the HU is currently at the bottom of the list, the HU shall wrap-around to the top of the list
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. A SiriusXM signal source is available and the vehicle has an active subscription
2. The HU Satellite Audio source is selected on the Cabin Output Channel
3. The HU is tuned to a receivable Satellite Audio channel
4. A list is displayed whose first and last entries are known and which is longer than one screen
5. The list is positioned one row above the bottom of the list
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Request Scroll Down once and read the list position
2. Request Scroll Down once more and read the list position
tcs.expected_result:
1. The list is at the bottom of the list and the last entry is shown
2. The list is at the top of the list and the first entry is shown
tcs.design_method: 邊界值分析 (Boundary Value Analysis, BVA)
